preconditions.name: f_variance_nondegenerate
preconditions.description: The F components carry non-zero variance across committed selections in every cell -- the numerator of the share statistic.

preconditions.name: nonf_variance_nondegenerate
preconditions.description: The NON-F (modulatory) components carry non-zero variance in every cell. SAME STATISTIC (a variance) that the load-bearing C2 share routes on -- if these are flat, f_variance_share is ~1.0 by STARVATION and the falsifier is unmeasurable, not confirmed.

preconditions.name: demotion_lever_engaged
preconditions.description: MECH-448 f_eligibility demotion reports active on at least MIN_DEMOTION_ACTIVE_FRAC of genuine selections in every treatment cell.
preconditions.control: e3.last_score_diagnostics f_eligibility_demotion_active, fresh-gated; worst treatment cell

interpretation.combination_rule: PASS requires C1 (a treatment arm lifts committed-class entropy above ARM_OFF on the pre-registered majority of seeds). The DIRECTION is then decided by C2, a PER-SEED PAIRED reduction of F's variance share vs ARM_OFF: C2 true -> supports (conversion required rebalancing F's share, as MECH-439 predicts); C2 false -> weakens (a lever converted WITHOUT reducing F's share, which is the claim's own registered falsifying signature). C1 false with F's share held above the monopoly bar -> supports (the confirming signature). C1 false otherwise, or any readiness precondition unmet -> the falsifier was NOT evaluated and the run is scored non_contributory / non_degenerate.

criteria.name: C1_a_treatment_arm_converts
criteria.description: At least one treatment arm lifts committed-action-class entropy above ARM_OFF on >= 3 seeds.

criteria.name: C2_converting_arm_reduces_f_variance_share
criteria.description: Every converting arm REDUCES F's variance share vs ARM_OFF by >= 0.05 on >= 3 PER-SEED PAIRED comparisons. FALSE while C1 is TRUE is MECH-439's own falsifying signature: a lever that converts WITHOUT reducing F's variance share.

custom_information.dv_symmetry_statement: DV = a variance RATIO over the E3 score decomposition at the selected candidate. Its symmetry group is joint positive affine rescaling of ALL components (cancels in the ratio) plus permutation of observations. The MECH-448/449 manipulation reweights F relative to the modulatory channels AND restricts the eligible candidate set, so it is NOT invariant under that group. Deliberately contrasted with the 12 braked runs, whose entropy-over-argmax DVs are RANK statistics and are invariant under any monotone transform of the scores.

evidence_direction_note: Governance 2026-08-21 gov-20260821-0203 ratified failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-936_2026-08-18.json: [2026-08-18, failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-936_2026-08-18]: V3-EXQ-936's manifest direction `weakens` should be changed to `non_contributory`. The load-bearing C2 criterion (per-seed paired reduction of f_variance_share >= 0.05) was ARITHMETICALLY UNREACHABLE, not merely unmet: the share is 1.0 to float64 resolution in all 8 cells (exactly 1.0, paired delta exactly 0.0, in 2 of 4 ARM_DEMOTION seeds), and firing C2 would have required var(non-F) to be 3.7e14 to 2.5e43 times larger. Cause: an unbounded E2 imagination rollout. F = compute_reality_cost is the SQUARED z_world step norm while every modulatory channel is at most linear in latent scale, so var(F) ~ var(non-F)^2 -- measured across the run's own 8 cells, OLS slope 2.020, R^2 0.978 over 54 orders of magnitude, against a predicted 2.000. Back-solved rollout magnitude reaches ||dz_world|| ~ 1.42e18, inside the 1e16-1e18 band V3-EXQ-569e measured on 2026-05-31 for this identical code path (SD-056 substrate_queue failure_record; clean ARM_0 baseline there was 0.39-0.77). The repair was BUILT for that incident (SD-056 amend lever (b), per-step rollout output norm clamp, e2_fast.py:694-747, validated V3-EXQ-617 PASS) and ships default-OFF; this run's declared parity ancestor V3-EXQ-689i arms it (True, ratio 2.0) and this lineage's baseline module contains zero occurrences of the flag. In float32 the consequence is stronger than dominance: std(non-F)/std(F) is below float32 eps in 7 of 8 cells, so the harm/residue/benefit/novelty/goal terms are ADDITIVELY ANNIHILATED in the score sum -- C1's conversion result survives only because MECH-448 acts on eligibility rather than on the additive sum. The claim was not tested; MECH-439 is neither supported nor weakened by this run. Status unchanged (candidate); epistemic_category standard (NOT substrate_ceiling -- see the autopsy's Section 9 for why a null instrument must not be counted as a ceiling hit).
